name: GA Cubers Banana Scramble 2026
information: **This competition does NOT have the standard 3x3x3 Cube event.** Instead, there will be other official events as well as some unofficial events. See the [Unofficial Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GACubersBananaScramble2026#79198-unofficial-events) for more information. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GACubersBananaScramble2026#79199-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5MDYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--55d04463db7d97e68854ce1ad4ffb960c1ed23fd/SOUTHEAST_5.png)
